The challenge of finding developers in Europe leads to many companies looking to outsourcing. For example, for a software development company in Austria, Germany or France, software development comes with the challenge of limited talent availability. But what about France? Do French IT services companies have a base for offering high-quality software development outsourcing to its clients?

Your Guide to Hiring Developers in France 

In the past five years, the tech industry of France saw huge growth and that helped the  country’s economy expand too. In fact, data shows that the industry grows at  7,06 % per annum, which is proof of its power in such an evolving area. 

France has an exciting info tech sector which is supported by many big companies, for example  Ubisoft and Deezer. Around  29000 companies work towards the country’s tech success. Boosting the operations of French IT companies, including software development companies in France, are  47700 IT professionals. These people play a major role in shaping the industry. 

In France, the most popular programming languages used by French developers are:  PHP, .NET, Lua, Python and Node.js. These languages help software developers create  scalable apps that suit different industry needs.
France’s IT sector also has a significant impact on the global tech export market. The country’s tech export value, standing at 97.53 billion, demonstrates its ability in  producing innovative technological solutions that resonate beyond its borders.

An Overview of The Major Tech Hubs in France

France hosts several thriving tech hubs, each with its own distinct character. Let’s take a closer look at France’s main tech centers.

  • Paris

Nestled along the Seine River, Paris stands tall not just for its iconic landmarks, but also as a buzzing tech hub with thousands of software developer Paris professionals. A tapestry of tech companies including Ubisoft, known for its video games, the music  streaming platform Deezer and the digital advertising powerhouse Criteo, have found their home in the City of Lights and employ front end developer Paris experts. For a web developer Paris, the average monthly salary is around $5820, drawing from a pool of thousands actively shaping the digital landscape of the city. 

  • Marseille

On the sun-kissed shores of the Mediterranean, Marseille is making waves in the tech realm. Emerging companies like Optis, specializing in software for virtual reality  simulations and Smartfunding, a rising star in the fintech arena, have chosen this port city as their base. If you’re a web developer Marseille, you can expect to pocket around $3800 per month. The developer community here is on the upswing, with enthusiasm and innovation at the core. 

  • Lyon

In the heart of the Rhône-Alpes region, Lyon’s culinary excellence is matched by its burgeoning tech scene. Cegid, a software giant focusing on business solutions, and Esker, specializing in document automation, contribute to Lyon’s tech fabric. As a web developer Lyon, your monthly earnings on average will be around $3200. However, a  more specialized worker, such as a Unity developer Lyon or a front end developer Lyon, can earn much more. Lyon boasts a tight-knit community of developers, fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange. 

  • Toulouse

Known as “La Ville Rose” due to its rosy terracotta buildings, Toulouse is painting the tech world with innovation. Aerospace giants Airbus and Safran Electronics, alongside a  cluster of startups, call this city home. If you’re a web developer Toulouse, your monthly income would be around $5458. The Toulouse tech community is vibrant and diverse, reflecting the city’s rich cultural tapestry. 

  • Nice

Nestled on the French Riviera, Nice isn’t just a pretty face – it’s becoming a tech hotspot. Air Support, a company focusing on aviation maintenance solutions, and Inria, a  renowned research center for computer science, are contributing to the city’s tech landscape. As a software developer in Nice, you’re looking at an average monthly salary of $4200. Despite its smaller size, Nice is nurturing a growing cohort of developers, adding their flair to the global tech symphony.

Trends in French Outsourced Software Development

According to a report by French international investment bank BNP Paribas, the French software industry is technically strong but it suffers from a few weaknesses.

Challenges facing the industry

These include:

  • French software companies have not been able to acquire a dominant position in the European market
  • French software as a whole suffers from marketing challenges
  • Each French software company faces challenges breaking into new markets around the world

A key hurdle for many technology companies in France is finding qualified talent. A Reuters report highlights the problem, indicating that data specialists and other highly skilled tech workers are especially hard to find. The situation is exacerbated by the rapid pace of change in the high end of the technology market, with demand for talent with all the skills outstripping supply.

The Technology Talent Problem of French Outsourcing Companies

In order to help overcome the challenges they face, many IT companies in France have turned to soft outsourcing. Done right, software outsourcing can make these companies even more competitive both in Europe and in world markets.

For example, among the French companies that have turned to outsourcing, large names include Michelin, the tire manufacturing company, and France Telecom. According to a Yale report, most French companies predominantly outsource to Central Europe and North Africa, where there is a high prevalence of French speakers. The gains from such outsourcing, however, tend to be 70% less cost, which is lower than the 90% lower costs experienced in India or China.

Paris competes with other European capitals like London in the tech scene. According to The Economist, the city is now alsi making big strides in attracting VC funding for its startups.

Marseille

The second large French city, with a population of over 800,000. Marseille is a port city and among the biggest tech centers in the country where you can find Web development company in France. Its Aix-Marseille French Tech initiative aims to make it a leader in French technology.

Lyon

It has around half a million inhabitants. Lyon has a notable dance music scene, many museums, and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Overcoming Challenges in Custom French Software Development

What is striking, however, is that none French software company of these three largest cities made it onto BusinessInsider’s ranking of 25 Most High-Tech Cities in the world. That ranking published by BusinessInsider was topped by San Francisco, followed by New York, with London, in 3rd position, as the highest ranked European city. This ranking echoes the research by French international bank BNP Paribas that the best French software and tech companies need to do more to elevate its status internationally. FAQs: Hiring Developers in France

Outsourcing IT professionals to top French tech companies provides access to a pool of skilled talent with diverse expertise. French developers often possess strong  technical skills and innovative thinking, which can enhance your projects. It’s a cost-effective way to tap into a skilled workforce at an IT company in France without the  overhead of traditional hiring.

  • How does the hiring process for developers in France usually work?

The process is straightforward. You share your requirements with an outsourcing partner, like Mobilunity, detailing the skills and experience you need. The partner then  scouts suitable candidates, conducts interviews and presents you with potential hires. Once you approve, the chosen developers become part of your team, working remotely to support your projects.

  • What types of skills can outsourced developers in France bring to my projects?

Outsourced developers from a French IT company can offer a wide range of skills, including web development, mobile app creation, software engineering and more. They can  also excel in languages like Java, Python and JavaScript. You can choose  developers from France IT companies with skills that align perfectly with your project requirements.

  • Can I maintain control over projects while outsourcing developers to France?

Absolutely! When you outsource developers to some of the best France tech companies, you can retain full control over your projects. You define the tasks, set goals and monitor progress. The outsourcing partner takes care of administrative tasks,  allowing you  to focus on project management and achieving your business objectives.

  • How can outsourcing IT professionals to France help my business grow?

To outsource in French can provide access to a wider talent pool, bringing in  expertise that may not be available locally. This  can lead to faster project completion and innovation, contributing to your business growth.

  • What are the potential challenges in outsourcing developers to France?

While outsourcing offers many benefits, there might be slight challenges in terms of time zone differences and communication. However, choosing a reliable  outsourcing partner can help minimize these challenges and ensure smooth collaboration with developers from a company specializing in software development in French.
